author: Dado154
quote: Driving isn't very fun which degrades the whole experience considering how much of it you have to do in a GTA game. Out of all the things they took from RDR, it's weapon system is perhaps the worst they could've chosen. Your weapon stash can't come to your exact location with a whistle in this game. You have to call for your car, sit through the call, and then run to wherever the car spawned. There's also the fact that you have to select the weapons to even be in your trunk in the first place. After a while it gets annoying when every npc who can see your weapon starts throwing a hissy fit and comments on it and only way to stop it is to drop it in your trunk and carry only sidearms. Cops can identify you by your long weapons which you can't stow away unlike in previous entries. The morality system feels more restrictive than it should. This is supposed to be a GTA game not Red Dead. The game's true merit lies in it's unmatched photorealism but looking pretty is not nearly enough when you've made your game's core mechanics unecessarily tedious for the sake of realism.
